# `kernel/navi/adapters/ConstructManifestationAdapter.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/navi/adapters/ConstructManifestationAdapter.js`

Narrow Construct manifestation boundary. The adapter deliberately captures only bound ActiveBody-style functions and explicit observation readers supplied by trusted kernel wiring. It never exposes the engine object, treats a body as identity, or derives authority from scene, presence, spatial, model, avatar, or body data.

## Functions

### `createConstructManifestationAdapter({ bodyId, bodyRuntime, manifestationId = NAVI_CONSTRUCT_PRIMARY_MANIFESTATION_ID, spawnPosition = [0, 0, 0], bodyOptions = {}, readActiveScene, readSelectedEntity, readVerifiedRealmPresence, readSpatialLocality, playAnimation, requestRealmAuthority, maxObservationBytes = DEFAULT_MAX_OBSERVATION_BYTES, clock = ()`

Create the trusted Construct runtime attached by NaviManifestationAdapterRegistry. bodyRuntime is expected to be an ActiveBodySystem-compatible object. Readers are narrow kernel wrappers; each receives a frozen exact-scope request.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
